tasks.title: Weather follows the consented device fix (3-decimal rounded, first-party proxy, never logged)
tasks.goal: /api/weather/current accepts optional validated coords=lat,lng; the client sends only the consented fix rounded to 3 decimals; the proxy queries Open-Meteo with those coords and returns coordinate provenance with fetchedAt. No fix or consent yields honest unavailable in Live; demo-city fallback is forbidden in Live and stays dev-only. Server never logs coordinates. D1 also owns the exact trusted-HTTPS demo-serve steps all device evidence depends on: mkcert LAN serve with the owner-installed phone root CA (exact iOS and Android steps), preview with that certificate via --host and same-origin /api through an npm script named demo:https (npm run demo:https); never self-signed click-through (geolocation after bypass is unverified); Android alternative USB debugging with chrome://inspect port forwarding; guaranteed fallback Mac http://localhost:4174; no tunnel, no public exposure. Resolves BACKLOG-20261103-WEATHER-DEMOCITY-P2.
